reason: It's free to send a request, and the label photos before handover are the first thing I've seen that helps me check the work from abroad. I'd send one request for my family's system, but I'd still post the offers in the Facebook group to see if the prices are fair.
objection: Photos of labels prove the equipment was there, not that it was installed properly or that it is the same gear on the roof at my family's house. And a new site with no reviews yet: who is SunXFinder, and will they actually push back on a company if something goes wrong?
